title: Evidence
description: A specific piece of content extracted from a source. Evidence is always tied to a specific source and a specific location within that source. Evidence carries NO polarity — the same extraction may support one claim and contradict another. How evidence relates to a claim (supports, contradicts, contextualises) is expressed on the ClaimEvidenceLink entity connecting them. Evidence not referenced by at least one ClaimEvidenceLink is orphaned and fails validation.

id.description: Stable entity identifier in format boe:evidence:<ulid>. Constant across versions.

source_id.description: The source this evidence is extracted from. Must reference an existing Source entity.

description.description: What this evidence is. Descriptive only — how it bears on any claim belongs on the ClaimEvidenceLink.

quote.description: Direct verbatim quotation from the source. Preferred over paraphrase where possible.

location.description: Specific location within the source: page number, paragraph, timestamp, section, or line range. Structured selectors (W3C Annotation-style) planned for a future schema version.

interpretation.description: Optional: what the investigator takes this evidence to mean, kept separate from the raw extraction.

reliability_notes.description: Any notes about the reliability or limitations of this specific piece of evidence.
